note: Master merged ca50836 cleanly into origin/main (`b0e9934`, all 6/6 `npm run verify` gates green!) and added `PropRegistryItem.appearance_summary` + `/api/media/create-prop` `appearance_summary` support in `main.py` & `shared/schema.json`. parallel_tasks.title: Fix Default `place` vs Explicit `catch_from_camera` Leak in `CameraSelfView.tsx` & `App.tsx`
parallel_tasks.details: User feedback audit caught two leaks where `catch_from_camera` / `held` still fire by default: (1) In `frontend/src/components/CameraSelfView.tsx`, change default `placement` state from `'held'` to `'table'` (`useState<PropPlacement>('table')`) and add an explicit placement/motion selector (`Rest on Table / Floor` -> `entryMotion='place'` default vs `Hand / Toss to Lia` -> `entryMotion='throw_arc'`, ONLY auto-selecting `'throw_arc'` when `promptedByStory && /hand|give|toss|throw|catch/i.test(throwHint ?? '')`); (2) In `frontend/src/App.tsx` (`handleSubmitThrow`, lines ~900-919), ONLY set `action: 'catch_from_camera'` on Lia when `payload.entryMotion === 'throw_arc'`! NEVER overwrite Lia's `action` to `'catch_from_camera'` when `payload.entryMotion === 'place'` or `payload.placement === 'table' | 'floor'` without explicit throw-arc intent.

parallel_tasks.title: Propagate & Display Captured `appearance_summary` for Visual-Faithful Props (Yellow Can, Black Phone)
parallel_tasks.details: Update `frontend/src/types/schema.ts`, `frontend/src/api/stageClient.ts`, and `frontend/src/App.tsx`: (1) Add optional `appearance_summary?: string;` to `PropRegistryItem` in `schema.ts` and preserve `data.appearance_summary` / `rawItem.appearance_summary` inside `createStageProp()`; (2) When `handleSubmitThrow` creates a prop from the corner camera, store `appearance_summary`, surface a crisp status line showing the matched traits (e.g. `Captured prop matched: <appearance_summary or name>`), and append `<prop_id>: <appearance_summary>` cleanly to `scene.environment_notes` on scenes `>= currentSceneId` so downstream 2.5D preview -> `/api/media/render-scene` keeps full color/material fidelity.
